1-MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASH, BIRINCHI BET (32-bet).

Yuqorida yashil-oq fonli sarlavha: 'Module' (och yashil ramkada, kulrang-yashil harflar) va yonida to'q yashil 'Self-Assessment 1' hamda qora '(Units 1 - 4)'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary' sarlavhasi.
1) 'Underline the correct item in bold.' O'nta gap, har birida qalin harfli ikki variant. Oxirida qiya harflarda '(10 marks)'.
2) 'Fill in the correct word.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: tropical, ancient, celebrate, short, destination, projects, accounts, anniversary, couple, friendly. O'nta gap. '(10 marks)'.
3) 'Fill in the gaps with prepositions from the list.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: to, of, in, for, till, from. Sakkizta gap. '(8 marks)'.

O'NG USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar' sarlavhasi.
4) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the present continuous.' Yuqorida SURAT: qizil fonda uch nafar ish kiyimidagi odam - oq sochli keksa erkak va qora tanli ayol hujjatga qaramoqda, o'ngda ko'zoynakli erkak mobil telefonda gaplashmoqda; pastda shahar maketi. (Bu surat 7-betdagi modul muqovasida ham bor edi.) Ostida o'nta gap. '(10 marks)'.
5) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past continuous.' Oltita gap (davomi keyingi betda).

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '32'.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct item in bold. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri variant tagiga chizing. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLAR LUG'ATI TEKShIRUVI.

  ⚠ Har gap ma'lum bir unitdan:
     1  - 1-unit (Tailand matni)
     2  - 2-unit (kosmos matni)
     3  - 2-unit (Liza matni)
     4  - 3-unit (Harrods matni)
     5  - 4-unit (alone/lonely)
     6  - 4-unit (pick up)
     7  - 4-unit (havo shari matni)
     8  - 4-unit (have in mind)
     9  - 1-unit (xarakter sifatlari)
     10 - 1-unit (tashqi qiyofa)


⚠ QIYIN JUFTLIKLAR:

  wills / features
     'a will' = iroda; 'features' = yuz
     tuzilishi.
     'STRONG WILLS' - 7-betdagi matnda.

  crew / audience
     'a crew' = ekipaj; 'an audience' =
     tomoshabinlar.
     13-betdagi 8-mashqda farqi
     tushuntirilgan.

  persuaded / hired
     'to persuade' = ko'ndirmoq;
     'to hire' = yollamoq.
     16-betdagi matnda IKKALASI ham bor.

  employs / spreads
     'to employ' = ishga olmoq;
     'to spread' = yoymoq.
     21-betdagi matnda IKKALASI ham bor.

  alone / lonely
     27-betdagi 7-mashqda farqi
     tushuntirilgan.

  pick / take
     'to pick sb up' = borib olmoq.
     'take' bilan bunday ibora yo'q.

  wailing / blowing
     'the wind BLOWS'; 'a siren WAILS'.
     28-betdagi 14-mashq.

  held / had
     'to HAVE sth in mind' - turg'un
     ibora.

  lazy / mean
     'lazy' = dangasa; 'mean' = xasis.
     'He doesn't like WORKING' - demak
     DANGASA.

  build / complexion
     'build' = gavda; 'a complexion' =
     yuz rangi.
     'a DARK complexion' - 6-betdagi
     1-mashqda.

items.textEn: 1  Thai people have strong ___ .
items.uz: Kuchli nima?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a will' = iroda.
⚠ 7-betdagi matnda: 'We are a happy people who
have STRONG WILLS'.
⚠ 'features' = yuz tuzilishi - 'strong' bilan
kelmaydi.

items.textEn: 2  Mission Control wakes the ___ up at 6:41 pm CST.
items.uz: Kosmik kemadagi odamlar guruhi qanday ataladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a crew' = ekipaj (kema, samolyot).
⚠ 'an audience' = tomoshabinlar (teatr).
⚠ 13-betdagi 8-mashqda farqi tushuntirilgan.

items.textEn: 3  Liza's friends ___ her to send a cassette to a record company.
items.uz: Do'stlari nima qilishdi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to persuade sb TO DO sth' = ko'ndirmoq.
⚠ 'to hire' = yollamoq - bu yerda mos kelmaydi.
⚠ 16-betdagi matnda: 'they PERSUADED me to send
a cassette'.

items.textEn: 4  Harrods ___ over 4,000 staff.
items.uz: Do'kon xodimlarga nima qiladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to employ' = ishga olmoq.
⚠ 'to spread' = yoymoq ('300 departments SPREAD
over seven floors').
⚠ 21-betdagi matnda IKKALASI ham bor - farqni
seziing.

items.textEn: 5  Leave me ___ , please.
items.uz: Meni yolg'iz qoldiring - qaysi so'z?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'alone' = yolg'iz (HOLAT).
⚠ 'lonely' = yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan
(HIS-TUYG'U).
⚠ 27-betdagi 7-mashqda farqi tushuntirilgan.

items.textEn: 6  James will ___ me up in his car.
items.uz: Mashinada borib olish qanday aytiladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to pick sb up' = borib olmoq.
⚠ 'to take sb up' - bunday ibora bu ma'noda
yo'q.
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada: 'Bob PICKED her up in
his car'.

items.textEn: 7  A gentle breeze was ___ in through the window.
items.uz: Shamol nima qiladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'the wind/breeze BLOWS' = esadi.
⚠ 'to wail' = uvillamoq (SIRENA).
⚠ 28-betdagi 14-mashqda tovush fe'llari.

items.textEn: 8  That wasn't what I ___ in mind.
items.uz: Ko'zda tutgan - qaysi fe'l?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to HAVE sth in mind' - TURG'UN ibora.
⚠ 'to hold in mind' - bunday ibora yo'q.
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada: 'what I HAD IN MIND'.

items.textEn: 9  George is very ___ . He doesn't like working.
items.uz: Ishlashni yoqtirmaydigan odam qanday?
items.whyUz:
⚠ "He doesn't like WORKING" - demak DANGASA.
⚠ 'mean' = xasis (pul haqida).
⚠ 8-betdagi 14-mashqda 'mean' tushuntirilgan.

items.textEn: 10  He's got a dark ___ .
items.uz: Yuz rangi qanday ataladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a complexion' = yuz/teri rangi.
⚠ 'build' = gavda tuzilishi ('medium build').
⚠ 6-betdagi 1-mashqda: 'a DARK COMPLEXION'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word. (10 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLAR LUG'ATIDAN.


⚠ QAYSI SO'Z QAYSI UNITDAN:

  celebrate    - 1-unit (Tailand)
  accounts     - 3-unit (Parij)
  tropical     - 1-unit (Tailand)
  projects     - 2-unit (kosmos)
  destination  - 1-unit (Tailand)
  friendly     - 1-unit (xarakter)
  ancient      - 1-unit (Tailand)
  short        - 2-unit (kosmos)
  anniversary  - 4-unit (hikoya)
  couple       - 2-unit (kosmos)


⚠ GAP MANTIG'IGA QARANG:

  1  'many festivals' → CELEBRATE
     (nishonlamoq)
  2  'big bank ___' → ACCOUNTS
     (bank hisobi)
  3  '___ climate and beautiful beaches'
     → TROPICAL (Fiji - tropik orol)
  4  'astronauts work on ___ involving
     satellites' → PROJECTS
  5  'a popular holiday ___' →
     DESTINATION (ta'til manzili)
  6  '___ people at the party' →
     FRIENDLY (samimiy odamlar)
  7  '___ temples in India' → ANCIENT
     (qadimiy ibodatxonalar)
  8  'a ___ break for lunch' → SHORT
     (qisqa tanaffus)
  9  'my parents' wedding ___ ... They
     got married in 1972' →
     ANNIVERSARY (to'y yilligi)
  10 'sleeps for a ___ of hours' →
     COUPLE (bir-ikki soat)


⚠ 9-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  'They got married in 1972' - bu
  KALIT: agar 1972-yilda uylangan
  bo'lsa, bugun - YILLIK.


⚠ 10-BAND - 'A COUPLE OF':

  ⚠ 'a couple OF hours' - 'of' ShART.
  ⚠ 13-betdagi 6-mashqda ham bor edi.

items.sentence: The Thais ___ many festivals throughout the year.
items.uz: Tailandliklar yil davomida ko'plab bayramlarni nishonlaydi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to celebrate a festival' = bayram nishonlamoq.
⚠ 7-betdagi matnda AYNAN shu gap bor.

items.sentence: Only people with big bank ___ can shop here, as it is very expensive.
items.uz: Bu yerdan faqat katta bank hisobiga ega odamlar xarid qila oladi, chunki juda qimmat.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a bank account' = bank hisobi.
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnida: 'shoppers with big
BANK ACCOUNTS'.

items.sentence: Fiji has got a ___ climate and beautiful beaches.
items.uz: Fijida tropik iqlim va chiroyli plyajlar bor.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a tropical climate' - 7-betdagi Tailand
matnida ham bor edi.
⚠ Fiji - Tinch okeanidagi tropik orollar.

items.sentence: The astronauts work on ___ involving satellites.
items.uz: Kosmonavtlar sun'iy yo'ldoshlarga oid loyihalar ustida ishlaydi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to work ON projects' - predlog 'on'.
⚠ 13-betdagi matnda: 'they work on PROJECTS
INVOLVING satellites'.

items.uz: Gavayi - ommabop ta'til manzili.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a holiday destination' = ta'til manzili.
⚠ 7-betdagi matnda ham bor edi.

items.sentence: I met some very ___ people at the party.
items.uz: Bazmda juda samimiy odamlar bilan tanishdim.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'friendly' - SIFAT, ravish EMAS
(27-betdagi qoida).
⚠ 7-betdagi matnda: 'The Thais are FRIENDLY
people'.

items.sentence: We visited several ___ temples in India.
items.uz: Hindistonda bir necha qadimiy ibodatxonaga bordik.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'ancient temples' - 7-betdagi Tailand matnida
ham bor edi.
⚠ 'antique' (antikvariat buyum) bilan
ADAShTIRMANG.

items.sentence: We have a ___ break for lunch at 1:30 pm.
items.uz: Soat 13:30 da tushlik uchun qisqa tanaffus qilamiz.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a short break' = qisqa tanaffus.
⚠ 13-betdagi matnda: 'The crew take a SHORT
BREAK for lunch'.

items.sentence: It is my parents' wedding ___ today. They got married in 1972.
items.uz: Bugun ota-onamning to'y yilligi. Ular 1972-yilda turmush qurishgan.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'They got married in 1972' - demak
bugun YILLIK.
⚠ 27-betdagi hikoyaning nomi ham shu:
'The Wedding Anniversary'.

items.sentence: Tim often sleeps for a ___ of hours in the afternoon.
items.uz: Tim ko'pincha tushdan keyin bir-ikki soat uxlaydi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a couple OF hours' - 'of' ShART.
⚠ 13-betdagi 6-mashqda ham bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with prepositions from the list. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi predloglar bilan to'ldiring. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-4-UNITLARDAGI PREDLOGLI IBORALAR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  1  to call FOR a taxi
     (27-bet, 8-mashq)
  2  to have sth IN common
     (8-bet, 11-mashq)
  3  to consist OF sth
     (8-bet, 11-mashq)
  4  to be proud OF sb
     (8-bet, 11-mashq)
  5  FROM 8 am TILL 4 pm
     (19-bet, 10-mashq)
  6  according TO sb
     (13-bet, 9-mashq)
  7  to wait FOR sb/sth
     (27-bet, 8-mashq)
  8  to take over FOR the night
     (13-bet, 9-mashq)

  ⚠ Hamma ibora ilgari o'rganilgan -
  bu TAKRORLASh mashqi.


⚠ 5-BANDDA IKKI PREDLOG:

  'FROM 8 am TILL 4 pm'
  ⚠ 'from ... till ...' - JUFTLIK:
  biri bo'lsa ikkinchisi ham ShART.


⚠ 'FOR' UCh MARTA IShLATILADI:

  1  call FOR a taxi
  7  wait FOR a taxi
  8  take over FOR the night

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda 'for' bir marta yozilgan,
  lekin uch joyda kerak - ro'yxatdagi
  so'zni QAYTA ishlatish mumkin.


⚠ 'OF' IKKI MARTA:

  3  consists OF
  4  proud OF

items.sentence: Can you call ___ a taxi, please?
items.uz: Taksi chaqirib bera olasizmi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' = taksi chaqirmoq.
⚠ 'to call sb' (predlogsiz) = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq -
BOShQA ma'no.

items.sentence: Bob and Marie have lots of things ___ common.
items.uz: Bob va Marida ko'p umumiy narsa bor.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to have sth IN common' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 7-betdagi Tailand matnida ham bor edi.

items.sentence: The village consists ___ a few houses and a church.
items.uz: Qishloq bir necha uy va cherkovdan iborat.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to consist OF' - HAR DOIM 'of'.
⚠ 7-betdagi matnda: 'A typical Thai village
CONSISTS OF wooden houses'.

items.uz: Meri qizidan faxrlanadi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'proud OF sb/sth' - HAR DOIM 'of'.
⚠ 7-betdagi matnda: 'PROUD OF our history'.

items.sentence: Shops are open ___ 8 am till 4 pm.
items.uz: Do'konlar ertalab 8 dan kechqurun 4 gacha ochiq.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - JUFTLIK.
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnida: 'open FROM eight ...
TILL about seven'.

items.sentence: Shops are open from 8 am ___ 4 pm.
items.uz: Do'konlar ertalab 8 dan kechqurun 4 gacha ochiq.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - JUFTLIK.
⚠ 19-betdagi Parij matnida: 'open FROM eight ...
TILL about seven'.

items.sentence: According ___ John, Chris broke the vase.
items.uz: Jonning aytishicha, vazani Kris sindirgan.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'according TO sb' - predlog 'to'.
⚠ DIQQAT: 'according to me' - XATO!
O'z fikringiz uchun 'in my opinion'.

items.sentence: He was waiting ___ a taxi when I saw him.
items.uz: Men uni ko'rganimda u taksi kutayotgan edi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to wait FOR sb/sth' - predlog ShART.
⚠ 'was waiting' + 'saw' - 4-unitning asosiy
qolipi.

items.sentence: At 8 pm, the night staff take over ___ the night.
items.uz: Soat 20:00 da tungi smena tun uchun navbatni oladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to take over FOR the night' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ 13-betdagi matnda AYNAN shu ibora bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the present continuous. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI.


⚠ QOIDA (10-betdan):

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
     odat, doimiy holat, umumiy haqiqat
     belgi so'zlari: always, usually,
        every day

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     hozir bo'layotgan ish, vaqtinchalik
     holat, yaqin kelajakdagi ANIQ reja
     belgi so'zlari: now, at the moment,
        tomorrow, tonight


HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1  'at the moment' → CONTINUOUS
  2  'tomorrow' - ANIQ reja →
     CONTINUOUS
  3  do'kon DOIMIY sotadi → SIMPLE
  4  'know' - HOLAT fe'li → SIMPLE
  5  'at this time of year' - ShU
     DAVRDA → CONTINUOUS
  6  'this afternoon' - ANIQ reja →
     CONTINUOUS
  7  narx DOIMIY → SIMPLE
  8  hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti →
     CONTINUOUS
  9  'tonight' - ANIQ reja → CONTINUOUS
  10 'every day' → SIMPLE


⚠ 4-BAND - HOLAT FE'LI:

  'Sue KNOWS a lot about computers.'
  ⚠ 'know' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS
  shaklda ISHLATILMAYDI.
  ⚠ 'is knowing' - XATO.


⚠ 7-BAND - 'COST':

  'It COSTS a lot of money.'
  ⚠ 'cost' ham HOLAT fe'li.
  ⚠ 'is costing' - XATO.


⚠ 2, 6, 9-BANDLAR - KELAJAK:

  'I AM SEEING Tom tomorrow.'
  'The space shuttle IS TAKING OFF
   this afternoon.'
  'Sharon IS COMING to my house
   tonight.'

  ⚠ Hammasi ANIQ, kelishilgan reja →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S:

  3  sells
  4  knows
  7  costs
  10 drives

  ⚠ -S ni UNUTMANG!


⚠ 'TO TAKE OFF':

  = uchib ketmoq (samolyot, raketa).
  ⚠ Aksi: 'to land' = qo'nmoq
  (30-betdagi hikoyada).

items.textEn: 1  They ___ (work) on an important project at the moment.
items.hintUz: 'at the moment' qaysi zamonni talab qiladi?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'at the moment' - PRESENT CONTINUOUS belgisi.
⚠ Ega 'They' → 'are'.

items.textEn: 2  I ___ (see) Tom tomorrow after work.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'tomorrow' + ANIQ reja → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'see' bu yerda 'uchrashmoq' ma'nosida -
shuning uchun continuous MUMKIN.

items.textEn: 3  This shop ___ (sell) rare books.
items.whyUz:
⚠ DOIMIY holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ Ega 'This shop' - 3-shaxs birlik → 'sellS'.

items.textEn: 4  Sue ___ (know) a lot about computers.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'know' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS shaklda
ISHLATILMAYDI.
⚠ 'is knowing' - XATO.
⚠ 3-shaxs birlik → 'knowS'.

items.textEn: 5  A lot of tourists ___ (visit) London at this time of year.
items.hintUz: 'at this time of year' - shu davrdagi ish
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'at this time of year' - ShU DAVRDA bo'layotgan
ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'A lot of tourists' - KO'PLIK → 'are'.

items.textEn: 6  The space shuttle ___ (take off) this afternoon. We can watch it on TV.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ANIQ, rejalashtirilgan ish → PRESENT
CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to take off' = uchib ketmoq; aksi 'to land'.

items.textEn: 7  It ___ (cost) a lot of money to fly to Australia.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'cost' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS BO'LMAYDI.
⚠ Ega 'It' → 'costS'.
⚠ 'It costs ... to do sth' - turg'un qolip.

items.textEn: 8  I don't want to go out because it ___ (rain).
items.whyUz:
⚠ HOZIR bo'layotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to go out' = tashqariga chiqmoq.

items.textEn: 9  Sharon ___ (come) to my house for dinner tonight.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ANIQ, kelishilgan reja → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'FOR dinner' - predlog 'for'.

items.textEn: 10  He ___ (drive) to work every day.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'every day' - ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 3-shaxs birlik → 'driveS'.
⚠ 15-betdagi 21-mashqda ham 'drive to work'
bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
4-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI TEKShIRUVI.

  ⚠ Bu mashqning davomi keyingi betda
  (33-bet).


⚠ QOIDA (29-betdan):

  PAST SIMPLE:
     tugagan, qisqa ish
  PAST CONTINUOUS:
     uzun ish, fon, uni bo'lgan ish


HAR BANDNING SABABI:

  1  'It was cold ... SO we lit a fire' -
     natija, qisqa ish → SIMPLE
  2  'I MET Ann WHILE I was doing the
     shopping' - uzun ish 'while' bilan
     → CONTINUOUS
  3  'The sun WAS SHINING WHEN John woke
     up' - fon → CONTINUOUS
  4  'He WAS READING a book WHEN the
     lights went out' - uzun ish →
     CONTINUOUS
  5  'They WERE CLEANING the house WHEN
     he called' - uzun ish → CONTINUOUS
  6  'She BROKE the computer WHEN she
     tried to move it' - IKKI qisqa
     ish → SIMPLE


⚠ 6-BAND - ISTISNO:

  'She BROKE the computer when she
   TRIED to move it.'

  ⚠ Bu yerda IKKALA fe'l ham PAST
  SIMPLE, chunki ikkalasi ham QISQA
  va KETMA-KET.

  ⚠ Qolgan bandlarda esa BITTA uzun +
  BITTA qisqa ish bor.


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:

  light → LIT (yoqmoq)
  break → BROKE (sindirmoq)
  meet  → MET (uchrashmoq)
  shine → SHONE (porlamoq)
  read  → READ (talaffuzi o'zgaradi)
  go    → WENT

  ⚠ 'lit' - 'lighted' ham to'g'ri,
  lekin 'lit' ko'proq ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'THE LIGHTS WENT OUT':

  = chiroq o'chdi.
  ⚠ 'to go out' bu yerda = o'chmoq
  (chiroq, o't).
  ⚠ 8-bandda esa 'to go out' = tashqariga
  chiqmoq edi - IKKI XIL ma'no!

items.textEn: 1  It was cold on Sunday night, so we ___ (light) a fire.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'so' - NATIJA bog'lovchisi; qisqa ish →
PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'light' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: light - lit - lit.

items.textEn: 2  I met Ann while I ___ (do) the shopping.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'WHILE' + UZUN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to do the shopping' - 12-betdagi 1a mashqida
ham bor edi.

items.textEn: 3  The sun ___ (shine) when John woke up that morning.
items.whyUz:
⚠ FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'when' dan keyin QISQA ish ('woke up').
⚠ 'shine' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: shine - shone - shone.

items.textEn: 4  He ___ (read) a book when the lights went out.
items.hintUz: Uzun ish, uni qisqa ish bo'ldi
items.whyUz:
⚠ UZUN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'the lights WENT OUT' = chiroq o'chdi
(qisqa ish).
⚠ 'read' - o'tgan zamonda /red/ deb o'qiladi.

items.textEn: 5  They ___ (clean) the house when he called.
items.whyUz:
⚠ UZUN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Ega 'They' - KO'PLIK → 'were'.
⚠ 'to call' bu yerda = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

items.textEn: 6  She ___ (break) the computer when she tried to move it.
items.whyUz:
⚠ ISTISNO: IKKALA fe'l ham QISQA va KETMA-KET →
ikkalasi ham PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'break' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: break - broke -
broken.

patterns.exampleEn: They are working on an important project at the moment.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular ayni damda muhim loyiha ustida ishlashmoqda.

patterns.exampleEn: He drives to work every day.
patterns.exampleUz: U har kuni ishga mashinada boradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'every day' - ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda -S ni UNUTMANG.

patterns.exampleEn: I met Ann while I was doing the shopping.
patterns.exampleUz: Xarid qilayotganimda Ann bilan uchrashib qoldim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'while' + UZUN ish → past continuous.
⚠ Bosh gapda QISQA ish → past simple.

patterns.exampleEn: Shops are open from 8 am till 4 pm.
patterns.exampleUz: Do'konlar ertalab 8 dan kechqurun 4 gacha ochiq.

patterns.exampleEn: According to John, Chris broke the vase.

items.derived: I don't want to go out.

items.baseUz: yoqtirmoq, sevmoq, yomon ko'rmoq, kerak bo'lmoq, tushunmoq
